rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the edible apple fruit.

example.english: I like eating an apple best.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ping4 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the tree that bears apples.

example.english: This apple tree bears lots of fruit every year.
example.traditional: 呢棵蘋果樹每年都結好多果。
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 ping4 gwo2 syu6 mui5 nin4 dou1 git3 hou2 do1 gwo2

rows.note: Use this for the forbidden fruit in the biblical story of Adam and Eve.

example.english: The Bible says Adam and Eve secretly ate the forbidden apple.
example.traditional: 聖經話亞當同夏娃偷食咗禁果。
example.jyutping: sing3 ging1 waa6 aa3 dong1 tung4 haa6 waa1 tau1 sik6 zo2 gam3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this for a fruit produced by a plant when the context is generic rather than referring to an edible apple.

example.english: This apple tree produced a lot of fruit this year.
example.traditional: 呢棵蘋果樹今年結咗好多果實。
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 ping4 gwo2 syu6 gam1 nin4 git3 zo2 hou2 do1 gwo2 sat6
